comments.author: pete-gov
comments.body:
> Is there a time limit on vendor dependencies or operational requirements from FedRAMP or the individual agency itself such as it can be approved for a year and renewed annually up till three or five years?

FedRAMP doesn't have a formal requirement regarding this that I'm aware of.

Note that under the Vulnerability Detection and Response Standard, the concept of "deviation requests" and POA&Ms are entirely eliminated for both 20x and Rev5, though adoption in Rev5 is still pending a beta.
